note: Windows (wine+FEX) counterpart to hollow-knight.json (box64/Linux). This record is for the PRODUCTION tree: `nix run .#hollow-knight`. USER-CONFIRMED end-to-end on 2026-08-10 — the production launcher booted HK, it rendered fullscreen (2560x1664@60) through native ARM64EC DXVK, and the user closed it via the in-game GUI with a clean teardown (no crash, no orphans). The 60fps figure was measured in the preliminaries POC on the IDENTICAL emulator closure (same DXVK/vkd3d/wine store paths). The launcher store path here reflects a later cosmetic rebuild (portrait splash + INT/TERM signal handling) that post-dates the confirmed run but does not touch the render path.

host.note: Apple M2 (G14G B0). The winefex stack is page-size-agnostic: the Windows FEX/box64 emulator DLLs don't compile jemalloc_glibc, so the 16K/64K walls that dogged the Linux FEX fork don't apply (config/hostcaps.nix).

backendReason: Windows-only x86_64 title path (also the template for BG3). x86_64 code runs as ARM64EC inside native-ARM64 wine (Hangover architecture) under FEX; no 4K Linux guest, no muvm.

emulatorVersions.wine: wine-hangover 11.15-arm64ec (AndreRH/wine@arm64ec, built by us; ARM64X-hybrid, dontStrip)
emulatorVersions.vkd3d: vkd3d-proton-arm64ec 2.14.1 (native ARM64EC PE: d3d12/d3d12core; reuses DXVK's dxgi)

renderer.path: D3D11/9 → native ARM64EC DXVK → Vulkan → Mesa (Asahi)
renderer.measuredFpsSource: preliminaries POC on the identical DXVK/vkd3d/wine store paths (RESEARCH §22 / wine-graphics-backend-findings)
renderer.note: wine's builtin wined3d-Vulkan present-stalls to ~12 fps here (architectural: synchronous present on the render thread, no presenter thread); DXVK's async presenter is the fix. wined3d-GL is also 60 (PROPNIX_WINE_D3D=wined3d fallback).
renderer.d3d12: ALSO WORKS via vkd3d-proton 2.14.1: `nix run .#hollow-knight -- -force-d3d12` (Unity flag) → vkd3d creates a D3D12 device + swapchain (2560x1664, 60fps target), fully rendering. Not the default (DXVK/D3D11 is the benchmarked path; D3D12 unbenchmarked for this 2D title). Both DXVK and vkd3d DLLs are installed on the dxvk backend, so either is reachable.

PROPNIX_WINE_D3D.reason: native ARM64EC DXVK → Vulkan (60 fps) vs wined3d-Vulkan's ~12 (RESEARCH §22). Default; override to wined3d.

PROPNIX_WINE_GRAPHICS.reason: HK renders cleanly on winewayland (single native window, native fractional scaling, no Xwayland). Only wart: undersized cursor on a scaled output (RESEARCH §12).

dllOverrides.reason: STRUCTURED map (from global winefex-defaults, not per-game): mscoree=builtin (suppress wine-mono prompt without breaking .NET), mshtml=disabled (drop gecko), winemenubuilder.exe=disabled (propnix ships the launcher's own .desktop). The launcher composes WINEDLLOVERRIDES from this and inserts the DXVK/vkd3d d3d*=n natives on the dxvk backend.

seal.model: targeted scrub — unset WINE*/FEX_*/BOX64_*/LD_*, keep the rest of the session env, then set the meant vars. NEVER env_clear()+allowlist (prefer-targeted-env-scrub). WINEDLLOVERRIDES is composed by the launcher from the structured dllOverrides map (see tunables.dllOverrides) + the DXVK/vkd3d natives.
seal.logging: DXVK/vkd3d log info to STDERR (no files); the launcher pipes the game's stdout+stderr, drives the splash close on the first-present marker (DXVK `Presenter:` / vkd3d `Creating swapchain`), and forwards to the terminal only under PROPNIX_BENCH/PROPNIX_WINEDEBUG — a plain run has a quiet console.

prefix.model: symlink farm at $XDG_STATE_HOME/propnix/hollow-knight/prefix (§7.2): read-only content symlinked from the store lower, writable content (HKCU/user.reg, the profile) real + persistent. No overlay/mount/namespace.

verifiedThisSession.userRegRealWritable: user.reg is a real 904KB file in the prefix
verifiedThisSession.dxvkDllsSymlinked: d3d11/d3d10core/dxgi/d3d9 → dxvk store; d3d12/d3d12core → vkd3d store
verifiedThisSession.saveBind: drive_c/users/propnix/AppData/LocalLow/Team Cherry/Hollow Knight → ~/.config/unity3d/Team Cherry/Hollow Knight (host dir created)

save.note: shares Unity's persistentDataPath with a native Linux build; userN.dat are engine-serialized + platform-independent, so the save game carries across (PlayerPrefs do not).

singleInstance.mechanism: flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) on $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/propnix/hollow-knight/lock, held by the outer launcher (fd is CLOEXEC → not inherited into wine, §5.1)
singleInstance.onDuplicate: exits 0 and attempts EWMH _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW raise matched by WM_CLASS — X11 only; a documented no-op under Wayland (a client can't activate another's surface). xdg-activation approach is backlog.
singleInstance.verifiedThisSession: no-config path exits 2; lock acquired on the --shell smoke run

splash.mechanism: GTK4 portrait window, forced BLACK theme (#000000 bg / white text via a CssProvider), showing the extracted app icon above the name + a spinner. Shown during cold start, dismissed the instant the launcher's pipe reader sees a first-present marker for ANY D3D backend — DXVK `Presenter:`, vkd3d `Creating swapchain`, or wined3d `@ approx …fps` (wine's fps channel, enabled via WINEDEBUG=-all,+fps on that backend) — all on STDERR, windowing-agnostic. Falls back to a 180s timeout (pure safety net; was a 20s blind timeout) or dismisses on game exit. Closing it before first-present cancels startup (SIGTERM the game's process group + prefix-scoped teardown).
splash.icon: auto-extracted from Hollow Knight.exe PE resources (icoutils) into a freedesktop hicolor theme (16→256px at share/icons/hicolor/<WxH>/apps/org.propnix.hollow-knight.png; found via XDG_DATA_DIRS; .desktop Icon=org.propnix.hollow-knight). Symbolic variant share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/org.propnix.hollow-knight-symbolic.svg (currentColor; vendored, CC BY-SA 4.0). Splash loads the largest via share/propnix/<id>.png.

backendMarkers.wined3d: @ approx N.NNfps (WINEDEBUG=-all,+fps) — verified appearing ~23s into a wined3d cold start; the old 20s blind timeout would have dismissed ~3s too early

splash.userConfirmed: the user launched HK (DXVK) and closed it via the in-game GUI; DXVK+vkd3d markers validated interactively; the wined3d @ approx marker verified in the launch stream.

teardown: prefix-scoped `WINEPREFIX=$pfx wineserver -k` on exit/cancel — reaps only this prefix's wine tree; NEVER a global process-name kill (would SIGKILL a concurrent wine app's wineserver).

payload.layout: the game tree directly (Galaxy content system; no InnoSetup/innoextract)
payload.credentialChannel: extra-sandbox-paths bind at /propnix; credentialDir named in /propnix/credentials.toml (never in the store, never printed)
payload.reproducible: verified: two independent gogdl downloads + a clean-sandbox FOD build reproduced this recursive hash (RESEARCH §7)
